nft_id.description: Identifier of the NFT in the companion NFT registry -- e.g. that app's entry/action hash for the token. Not interpreted by this code; carried through as an opaque string.

price.description: The exact fuel amount the buyer's escrow lock must match, scoped to unyt_index above.

receiver.description: The seller's own payout agent key.

listing.description: Parked by the seller role -- the listing (which NFT, at what price, paid to whom). (aggregate_execution: false -- delivered as ONE { data, link_hash } envelope, and the engine's validator strips the envelope, so this schema describes the payload itself, not an array.)

escrow_lock.description: Parked by the buyer_spender role -- the buyer's locked payment for this listing. (aggregate_execution: false -- delivered as ONE { data, link_hash } envelope, and the engine's validator strips the envelope, so this schema describes the payload itself, not an array.)
